description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two methods, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 with tick marks at regular intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla method is depicted by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It begins at a loss greater than 2.75 near 0 seconds, experiences a steep decline to approximately 2.65 at 50,000 seconds, and gradually levels off to end at a loss of roughly 2.63 near 250,000 seconds. The SepLLM method is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. It also starts above a loss of 2.75 near 0 seconds, declines sharply to about 2.65 at 40,000 seconds, and steadily decreases to end at approximately 2.61 near 220,000 seconds. The plot includes green dashed annotations: a horizontal dashed line connects a green star marker on the SepLLM line at approximately 190,000 seconds to a green star marker on the Vanilla line at approximately 240,000 seconds, both at a loss level of roughly 2.63. Vertical green dashed lines drop from these star markers toward the x-axis, with a green double-headed arrow and the text "1.26x" positioned between them.
